label: 1754S
scope: Separately frozen common-chart raw-fiber countertest, not amendment or physical admission
derivation:
1754S. Separate raw-fiber countertest on a fixed admitted background, without replacing its exterior field. This does NOT alter the native boundary datum1754 or turn its example into a realized sector.

Let U0 be a fixed real/unitary background for which the old native means/relative means and the chosen fixed physical M_fix are defined on the needed common charts. No assertion is made here that all physical backgrounds satisfy the older source hypotheses; those remain a prior gate. M_fix is the unchanged chosen CMP109(0.4) or(0.12), not a newly selected alternative. Both permitted formulas preserve the identity and are point-gauge equivariant. Keep its actual global field domain, X and fixed V0=U0 on E_fix. Suppose X contains an active complete physical L-block around a coarse representative y, and choose z_star=y+(1,1,0,...), with L odd>11, inside X, inside the native anchored block B_old(y), and not on the common coarse representative grid. The required common embedded coarse grid is explicit here; no equivalence of old and physical block conventions is inferred from it. Let c=(y,y+Le1), an active coarse row because y is active. Choose the patch without torus wrapping; if such an embedded common-chart patch is unavailable in the actual fixed instance, this test is not an admission of that instance.

Choose fixed nonzero Hermitian T in the Lie algebra of the same original compact group. Let P=U0(Gamma_{y,z_star}) be the native background transport along the source path. For sufficiently small a>0 set

 h(z_star)=P^(-1) exp(i aT) P, h(z)=I otherwise,
 U_a(v,w)=h(v)U0(v,w)h(w)^(-1), W_a=U_a U0^(-1) linkwise.

This changes no prescribed fine coordinate: the only nontrivial endpoints are in X, so every link with both endpoints outside X remains exactly V0. h is I at ALL coarse representatives and at every site outside X. The actual fixed physical mean therefore satisfies M_fix(U_a)=M_fix(U0) on all coarse rows by its point-gauge equivariance. This puts U_a and U0 in the same BARE original coarse-constraint/fixed-exterior fiber wherever it is defined. It is a raw constraint statement, not equality of full sector/gauge weights or membership in a final gauge section. Gauge-invariant curvature/action are unchanged, but no claim is made that every gauge-dependent indicator or hard axial gauge is preserved.

Now evaluate the OLD source background-relative mean R(U0)W_a, the actual operation of CMP98(63)/(89), not the physical mean or an invented linear average. The original old mean of W_a U0=U_a equals the old mean of U0, because its point gauge endpoints also have h=I. Thus the middle relative factor in(63) is I. The relative native path transport telescopes to

 (R0,y W_a)(Gamma_{y,z})=h(y) Ad_{U0(Gamma_{y,z})}(h(z)^(-1)).

It is exp(-i aT) only for z=z_star and I for every other z of B_old(y); h(y)=I. The analogous paths in B_old(y+Le1) all give I because the blocks are disjoint and h has only the one supported site. Equation(63) therefore gives EXACTLY

           (R(U0)W_a)(c)=exp(i aT/L^d) != I,
           (R(U0)I)(c)=I.

The background conjugation in h was chosen to make this equality exact, not to change U0 or V0. No coarse background transport is dropped: its right-hand adjoint acts on I in this example. Source logs remain on their small branch by taking a sufficiently small. For U0=I this specializes to the same rational coefficient1/13^4 when L=13,d=4, but U0 and V0 have NOT been reset to I in the general construction.

Consequently a direct replacement of the physical point-equivariant coarse constraint by this old background-relative constraint changes the BARE raw fixed-exterior fiber under these common-chart hypotheses. Along this raw gauge curve the first is constant and the second has nonzero derivative iT/L^d at a=0. This refutes the naive equality of these coarse maps, and of their coarse-only tangent kernels, not the equality of correctly reconstructed final constrained operators. It does not identify H/Hsharp, gauge projections or physical response kernels.

The same h fails the final averaged-gauge restriction: at y its background gauge average from CMP98(78) is exp(i aT/L^d), not I. Thus it is NOT an allowed counterexample within the final averaged gauge section. A correct physical-to-native fiber map must include its genuine gauge selection and boundary datum B, with any Jacobian and source/mark transformation. Main1754 describes a distinct native OLD-boundary B calculation; the present supported point is INSIDE X and the two examples are not silently identified. Neither gives a positive first-RG sector, a normalized measure identity or a physical profile. No chosen physical mean, fixed group, coupling, cutoff, original exterior, domain or marks have been replaced.
